reference_method: Independent Decimal ln(end)-ln(start) at 200/400 digits; both references agree. Finite positive binary64 price inputs have finite model log returns.
runnable_probe:
import math,json,sys
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
import section_8_05 as s
T,M=math.ulp(0.),sys.float_info.max
cases=[(M,T),(T,M),(1e300,1e-300),(T,1.),(M,M/2),(1.,math.nextafter(1.,2.)),(1.,math.nextafter(1.,0.)),(T,T)]
rows=[]
for a,b in cases:
 refs=[]
 for prec in (200,400):
  with localcontext() as ctx:
   ctx.prec=prec
   refs.append(float(Decimal.from_float(b).ln()-Decimal.from_float(a).ln()))
 assert refs[0]==refs[1]
 try:
  actual=s.log_return(a,b)
  if not math.isfinite(actual):actual=repr(actual)
 except Exception as exc:actual=type(exc).__name__
 rows.append(dict(start=a,end=b,expected=refs[0],actual=actual))
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
